notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: kupa_!
notes.content: [h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2][p][/p][p] Hi all, kupa_ here, one of the developers for Robot Rumble 2 back with another Dev Diary for you. Today I want to talk a little more about what the plan is for the next Major Update. We know a lot of you are excited to play with all the new toys and features, and we cannot wait to see what you create with them once the update drops. Progress has been steady, so let's get on with the show![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/3884ea6a78c6c60bfaefc742d8b018fa0bc4d1b5.png"][/img][i]Rosethorn takes a bite out of Heavens Time in the Rampified community arena! Both bots built by @jerrie11, and the arena by @cutiepatootie in the RR2 Discord![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Progress on the next major update![/b][/p][p]As mentioned in the last Dev Diary the next Major Update for RR2 is a big one, and we are functionally treating this as an opportunity to soft relaunch the game with the knowledge we have gained from the original release of the game in terms of what was missing and what could be improved going forward. To this end we have put together an internal roadmap of the big ticket items we want to include to make the game feel more complete and inviting to new roboteers.   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/dbff2c8d67a432b90b8f00909a9801418b609580.png"][/img][i]Hedgypig the Second shows Cart-nage the ropes in the Classic Clash community arena! Both bots build by @eli.the.boye in the RR2 Discord![/i][/p][p][/p][p]One of more subtle missing features of the game is the lack of music. Fans who have followed the game for a while are aware that the game did in fact used to have a score, but it is no longer present. With that in mind - we are excited to reveal that we have commissioned a bespoke OST exclusively for the game that will be introduced in the next Major Update. 7 brand new tracks are in the works, covering all aspects of the game. Chill subtle beats break up the silence of longer sessions in the BotLab, while Battles are now amplified by more action-packed tracks that escalate as the fight goes on![/p][p]This is a super exciting step forward in polish and even just playing the early versions of these tracks when testing the game has elevated the enjoyment factor immensely. Please see a preview below for the new main menu theme: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/64qecKYney0"][/dynamiclink][i]Please be aware that this is a work in progress so could change before the next Major Update, let us know what you think of it so far.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In the last Dev Diary we revealed the first of the new Stock Robot teams being added in the next Major Update. It is my pleasure to now reveal the next team our Community Contributor team have been working on - Hard Candy! Powerful full body spinners - and a couple cheeky overheads - for full 360 degrees of danger! [/p][p]Long time fans of the game may recognise the heavyweight - Bubblegum - as one of the original testing robots in the game before the inclusion of the BotLab. It's had a bit of an upgrade since then, so be careful of it's sweet tooth, as it packs a mean bite:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/05dcaf3332abfab698f32c9bec0e605b2a4843cf.png"][/img][i]What will you build to counter the all round power of team Hard Candy? Let us know down below and in the official RR2 Discord![/i]   [/p][p][/p][p]As always, a massive thank you to all who have supported the game and we cannot wait to show you more in the next Dev Diary.  [/p][p]kupa_ [/p][p]Robot Rumble 2[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2"]https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/582e0cdae77da6444cb336c398c554ffcb875647.png"][/img][i]Arcane and Synergy V2 clash in the Volcanic Sanctuary community arena! Both bots built by @copium_overdose in the RR2 Discord![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]This updates header features Caged Menace built by yours truly.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: kupa_!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2][p]
Hi all, kupa_ here, one of the developers for Robot Rumble 2! Firstly, a quick apology for missing last months Dev Diary. The team has been hard at work on some major new features and the month just ended up flying by! What has the team been working on, I (don't) hear you ask? Well read on and find out!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/4100cedfb0279662b210d4c9daec90ab77070ab5.png"][/img][i]The Golden fires Crumble Tumble up in to the air with a powerful hit in the community BH4 Arena! Both bots built by @iforgottofocus in the RR2 Discord.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Dreaded Scaling Bug Fix![/b][/p][p]The Scaling Bug has plagued RR2 since its inception, causing all Shapes (Custom or otherwise) to be the wrong weights compared to real life. The name comes from the fact that scaling a Shape up or down would dramatically increase and decrease its weight compared to its volume. This also resulted in oddities with hollow shapes being the same – or in some cases a higher – weight when compared to their solid counterparts, effectively making them decorative at best, and a downgrade at worst. This has been one of the biggest issues with building accurate robots in RR2 due to the massive effect it has on the weight of a bot, leading to the current state of vastly overpowered bots running armour and motors that real-life robotics teams could only dream of.[/p][p][/p][p]Luckily this has all come to a close, and we are happy to announce that the Scaling Bug has in fact been vanquished! We have been testing intensively with our Discord Community (link at the bottom of this post if you'd like to join us) and have found that this has breathed a whole new lease of life in to the meta, promoting more realistic, specialised bots and boosting up the use of motors and materials that are designed to fit certain niches that just weren't present in the older builds of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/8f0d7b550774464878103098f3e5a601cc68147e.png"][/img][i]Hornet triumphantly lifts Fire-blaze in the community Riverside Arena! Both bots built by @meikagreycloak in the RR2 Discord.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There is of course the flip side of this change: all existing bots have changed weight, some more extremely than others. On average we have seen peoples heavyweight bots balloon to around 1.5x their current weight. In some extreme cases we have had a couple of bots in testing end up at [i]three times[/i] their current weight! This means that some bots may be beyond saving without major redesigns or even full rebuilds. Due to this - and the list of planned new features and changes we are still working on - we are branding the next Major Update as a sort of soft relaunch of the game. More information on this will be in future Dev Diaries.[/p][p][/p][p]However, to mitigate part of that pain and to ensure everyone at least has something to play with day one of the new update, please allow me to introduce another treat coming in the next Major Update:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/1a5177c61f995fe7086f2ef7d7a161f313d27e20.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Stock Bot Teams Part 1![/b] [/p][p]We are happy to announce that we are bringing the first full set of Stock Robots in to the game! The current Stock Heavyweights were only meant to be a placeholder for a much more full roster of stock bots however this project fell by the wayside a little, luckily we have an amazing community who were more than happy to help out! For the next Major Update we are planning on introducing EIGHT stock teams, each with FIVE bots across multiple weightclasses to play around with for a grand total of [i]40 new stock bots[/i]. Each team will have its own theme and specialisation to ensure that each one stands out and requires different strategies to defeat in the arena. Above you can see the bots of our first team - [i]Meta Menaces[/i] - featuring futuristic designs and deadly vertical spinners! [/p][p][/p][p]That's not all, because there is one last bit of news we are happy to reveal that will make sharing and playing with our thousands of community bots even easier than ever:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/ed779f51924351748a3ba1178cb1dae2860aa2b4.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]That's right, we are in the final stages of getting Workshop support up and running! Watch this space for more information in future Dev Diaries.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, we have also been working on improving performance and fixing bugs whilst working on the above and cannot wait to share more information on our plans next month! Once again a massive thank you to all who have supported the game and the team![/p][p][/p][p]kupa_ [/p][p]Robot Rumble 2 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2"]https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/de880a752ceb6438e659aae756db38f89e5352ec.png"][/img][i]Huge sparks as Spoingus and MK III KiloNova go weapon to weapon! Bot bots built by @squawkingchickenrobotics[/i] [i]in the RR2 Discord.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]This updates header features Skarred built by yours truly.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: DocDoyle!
Robot Rumble 2 - Feature Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

We are pleased to announce the next major update for Robot Rumble 2! This update brings huge improvements to bot AI, some highly requested components, and the first ever new Game Mode: King of the Hill!

As always, a full changelog can be found at the end of this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/8533430eebe4e8feca7d3dd5e8ee4e4c72fe0980.png[/img][i]A huge shower of sparks as Twinzer V4 and Citrus Charge go weapon to weapon! Both bots built by @skyariaviolet on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

The major feature for this update is the introduction of different Game Modes in Robot Rumble 2! The first new Game Mode we are adding, King of the Hill, mixes up the rules by shifting the focus to holding an objective as opposed to outright destruction. In the centre of the arena is a small zone your bot needs to stay in to earn points towards victory. You'll earn more points if you're the only bot in the zone, so make sure to stake your claim and defend the point with all your might to win!

With this new game mode comes [i]two[/i] new arenas! We spoke about [i]Eye of the Storm[/i] in our previous Dev Diary, and this time around we'd like to introduce you to the [i]Octodrop[/i] arena! A King of the Hill arena designed for lower weightclasses. At 1 minute left on the clock the segments around the centre drop away, shrinking the safety net  around, and the possible paths to, the all important scoring zone. We are sure this will lead to same frantic final moments as the clock ticks down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/005e9a4569ba659f3ae8cc302dac7d39cfe26966.png[/img][i]A first look at the new Octodrop Arena.[/i]

Alongside the game, our Arena Modding Tool is receiving it's own Major Update with all new features and tools to play with for our community Arena Creators, including a new, highly requested Arena Hazard - The Forced Countout Zone - and support for creating your own King of the Hill arenas. Check out the previous Dev Diary if you'd like to learn more about the AMT.

We are also introducing a couple of highly requested new motors in this update: the Motenergy M0909 
 - which has been teased for far too long - and the Dual Scooter Motor for our classic era bot builders. But that's not all that is new in the BotLab, for we have also cooked up a new material called Glowing Decoration. This new material acts like the existing Decoration material, however, as the name implies, it glows in any colour you could want. This can be used for simulating LED strips, custom lights, or even just to to spice up your design with new visual effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/82605801ac306ddf83219d80cb0749d149da04a9.png[/img][i]Green Man sporting it's iconic internal glow. Bot built by @drola on the RR2 Discord Server.[/i]

The final big feature for this update is the inclusion of the community favourite Hobo AI as the new default AI when building new bots. This AI code is both more powerful than the previous default AI code, as well as much more user friendly, sporting many prebuilt behaviour modes to choose from and support for nearly every weapon archetype you can imagine.

Alongside all the above we have been busy squashing bugs, including finally putting an end to the pesky "Part Drift" when the game was paused in a match for a long time. Work has already begun on the next Major Update, and it is sizing up to be one of the most game-changing yet. We cannot wait to show you more soon in our future Dev Diaries, so be sure to stay tuned!

As always, we are eternally grateful for your support, and we cannot wait to see you in the arena!

- The Robot Rumble 2 Team
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/a32c29fe64df934e38f9b5d51b77d2f3e7a5a622.png[/img][i]A massive strike from High Strung sets Z-Type's batteries ablaze! Bots built by @la_machine on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

[i]This updates header features Actaon and Hellion. Both bots built by @ranking on the RR2 Discord Server.[/i]

[h2]Full Changelog Below:[/h2]

[Added] Battle/AMT - New Hazard type - Forced Countout Zone. Robots within this zone will be counted down as if immobile even if able to move, like an OOTA that you might be able to escape. Toggled with the Countouts Active option.
[Added] Battle/AMT - New Trigger type - ParticleTriggerZone. Toggles a particle system when a bot enters/leaves the zone.
[Added] Battle/AMT - New Utility - ArenaTextReplacer. When placed on a gameObject with a Text component dynamically replaces the following text during the match:
- %TIMER% - Displays the current Timer formatted as MM:SS, useful for custom UI or a display screen.
- %Px% - Displays the name of the bot in slot x. Blank if no bot in slot x.
- %PxSTATUS% - Displays Active or Eliminated depending on if bot is alive. Blank if no bot in slot x.
- %PxNAMEORSTATUS% - Displays the name of the bot in slot x OR, if the bot is eliminated, Eliminated. Blank if no bot in slot x.
[Added] BotLab - Scale Markers to BotLab grid.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Support for different GameModes in Arena Data (Currently Battle and King of the Hill for now, more to come down the line)
[Added] Battle/AMT - New ArenaProperties Script - When added to your prefab this will allow easier customisation of Arena Name, Preview (no more specifically named files needed), and allow you to select which GameMode the arena is for.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Ability to switch between GameModes in Battle Arena Selection. All "Legacy" arenas will show in the Battle mode.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Separate Arena Lists for different GameModes, only arenas in the currently selected GameMode will be shown.
[Added] Battle - Option when selecting arena to change score required for winning KOTH.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Added new Utility - KingOfTheHillZone. Bots in this zone will score points per second. Option to enable scoring different amount of points if the Zone is contested. By default if a single bot is in the Zone they will earn 2 points per second, and if multiple bots are in the zone they will all earn 1 point per second.
[Added] Battle - Two new Arenas:
- Eye of the Storm - A King of the Hill arena designed for Heavyweight Robots.
- Octodrop - A King of the Hill arena designed for Featherweight Robots.
[Added] Battle/BotLab - Bot AI can now be aware of KotH zones, and can get the closest KotH zone using the new in-built function getClosestScoringZone(p1) where p1 is a position to check from.
[Added] Battle - Bots can now win matches in KotH zones by earning the right amount of points.
[Added] Battle - If a KotH match times out, then the bot with the most points is the winner.
[Added] AI - new in-built function isRobotScoring. Will return 1 when the robot is in the KotH Zone, and 0 otherwise.
[Added] AI - Arena Hazard Trigger Zones, OOTA Zones, and Forced Countout Zones are now visible to the bot AI. You can get the closest hazard using the new in-built functions:
- getClosestHazard(p1) where p1 is a position to check from. Returns the center of the closest hazard to p1.
- getClosestPointOnHazard(p1) where p1 is a position to check from. Returns the nearest point on the edge of the nearest hazard to p1, good for avoiding OOTA zones.
[Added] AI - The type of the closest Arena Hazard can now be read by the AI using the new in-built function getTypeOfClosestHazard(p1) that will return a string of the following for each hazard type:
- OOTA Zones - OOTA
- Moving Hazard - MovingHazard
- Momentary Hazard - MomentaryHazard
- Impulse Hazard - ImpulseHazard
- Forced Countout Zone - CountoutZone
[Added] BotLab - The Collider Count returns, clicking on Parts Attached will switch between Parts Attached and Collider Count.
[Added] Main Menu - In-game changelog button that will show a simplified version of the latest updates changelog.
[Added] Battle - When in a KotH match a UI is displayed to keep track of each bots score.
[Added] Battle/AMT - New Trigger Type - Active Triggers. These can be used to set the active state of an object.
[Added] Battle/AMT - New Trigger Types - RandomTriggers. These triggers will trigger a random hazard or animation from a list for that extra sprinkle of randomness.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Arenas now have a Target Weightclass and can be filtered down by this in the Arena Select menu. Legacy Arenas are all set to Heavyweight.
[Added] Battle/AMT - Arena Selection buttons now show the target weightclass in the top left of the button.
[Added] Battle - Ability to refresh arenas in game, no more needing to restart to add in an arena!
[Added] Battle/AMT - ArenaTextReplacer now replaces the following text:
- %PxSCORE% - Displays the score of the bot in slot x. Blank if no bot in slot x.
[Added] BotLab - New Material - Glowing Decoration. Glow returns, and without needing to utilise glitches to achieve it. Acts like other decorative materials in that there is no collisions.
[Added] Battle - Torch and Pointer to FreeCam. Torch can be toggled on and off with right click, and the Pointer activates whilst the left click is held down.
[Added] Battle - When in FreeCam holding down Alt will slow the camera to half speed for more precision.
[Added] Battle/AMT - New Trigger - AnimTriggerMatchEnd - As the name suggests fires an animation when the match ends, whether that is through Time Out, Elimination, KotH Score Victory, or any other victory condition down the road.
[Added] BotLab - Added a new kind of breakable connection "NonWeld" which is used for any component not tied correctly into weld yet, this will be used to fix them down the line

[Change] Main Menu - Updated Credits.
[Change] Battle/AMT - AnimTriggerZone can now fire more than once.
[Change] Battle/AMT - All TriggerZones can now be assigned a wait time before firing. A bot must remain in the trigger zone for the wait time before it will fire. This can be used to create flippers or pits that only fire if a bot has waited on them for a set amount of time.
[Change] Battle - Increased max width of Win Text to accommodate longer bot names before wrapping.
[Change] Battle/AMT - Refactored how Arena Data is stored and accessed.
[Change] Battle/AMT - Improved loading performance of Arenas and Arena Menu generation.
[Change] Multiple Arenas can now be packaged in to 1 Arena file.
[Change] Battle/AMT - Refactored ArenaTextReplacer to improve performance and ease of use, no longer needs to be placed in the AMT to function.
[Change] BotLab - Added tooltip to Screenshot button that shows where the file is saved.
[Change] BotLab - Screenshots taken with the Screenshot button now automatically crop themselves to just the bot.
[Change] Battle - Optimised the way Arena Hazards are triggered. 
[Change] Battle - Removed linear component of the body velocity limiter, this improves hammer and flipper damage interactions, bots can now go faster then 20m/s.
[Change] BotLab/Battle - Adjusted way the Bot Select Panel finds bots to allow for filtering to different Robot Save File versions.
[Change] Further optimisations to the way Arenas are stored.
[Change] BotLab - Minor Updates to Materials and Tint UI.
[Change] BotLab - Tint Sliders now use 0-256 instead of 0-1, should make replicating colours a lot easier.
[Change] Battle - Tidied up Arena Select Screen a little, added some tooltips where needed.
[Change] BotLab - Tweaks to Glowing Decoration material.
[Change] Battle - FreeCam no longer requires right click to be held to rotate.
[Change] Battle - FreeCam now uses Shift as up instead of Space.
[Change] Battle/AMT - AnimTriggerTimer and AnimTriggerTimeRandom now have a field to choose when they fire in an Infinite time match. If this is set to 0 then the animation will not fire when Inf time is selected.
[Change] BotLab/AI - Updated Default AI to use Hobo AI V1.3.
[Change] BotLab - Updated Spinner hums to now utilise animationcurves, this gives more flexibility and improves performance.
[Change] BotLab - Reworked spinner hum analysing logic, spinners should now sound slightly more different from one another: more woosh from bars, more HMMM from discs, and improved super high rpm sound quality.
[Change] BotLab - Spinner hum is now more flexible and can be expanded with different sounds easier.
[Change] Battle - Default Arenas updated including complete overhaul of Origin Arena.
[Change] slightly adjusted angle adjustment for high bite engagements to be less radial and more tangential, aka spinners will more often throw into their spin direction instead of outwards in high bite situations.
[Change] Updated Default Arenas.
[Change] Added new function to tidy older Default Arenas.

[Bugfix] Battle - Eliminated Pause Part Drift.
[Bugfix] Battle - Bot velocities are now properly restored when unpausing.
[Bugfix] Battle - Bots eliminated via OOTA/Pit still being tracked by cameras.
[Bugfix] Battle - Further tweaks to cameras to eliminate tracking drifting when switching to cameras.
[Bugfix] Battle - Camera Rotation setting was being enabled even when disabled in AMT.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Typo Sphere = Half -> Sphere - Half.
[Bugfix] Battle - Multiple arenas of the same name and/or duplicate arenas cause the Arena Menu to not load properly.
[Bugfix] Battle - Fixed an issue where the damage multiplier would influence the impulse of spinner hits and spinner speed reduction
[Bugfix] Battle - Fixed an issue where the static spinner collider would not trigger any collisions.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Fixed a broken reference that made spinners break in test area.
[Bugfix] Battle/AMT - NullReference in ArenaTextReplacer that causes lockups when countdown completes.
[Bugfix] AI - AI unable to use Analog Controls (lever1 and lever2).
[Bugfix] Battle/AMT - ArenaTextReplacer sometimes fails to get Bot Name.
[Bugfix] Battle/AMT - ArenaTextReplacer null reference due to trying to add text to GameObjects without a text component.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Exit Without Saving sometimes still updated botfile incorrectly.
[Bugfix] BotLab - More instances where Exit Without Saving would still update botfile incorrectly.
[Bugfix] Battle/AMT - ParticleTriggerZone not properly triggering particles.
[Bugfix] Battle - NullReference in Arena Menu Generation.
[Bugfix] Battle - FreeCam not KotH UI.
[Bugfix] BotLab - ACTUALLY added the Motenergy M0909 motor like a sister of the ME0708, slightly longer but a smaller diameter, will probably require some more cont amp tuning as it is probably too low, just like the 0708 being somewhat overspecced to reach "reliable" operation with a solenoid.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Fixed the ME0708 motor that was apparently ~5mm too long.
[Bugfix] Battle/AMT - AnimTriggerTimerRandom and ActiveTriggerTimerRandom would trigger on every frame once fired.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Fixed an issue where test Crates would not be hit hard by spinners.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Fixed an issue where test Crates would weirdly float and behave strange moved.
[Bugfix] BotLab - Fixed an issue where the weld strenght impact limiter would sometimes return 0 on certain parts and not impart any spinner spindown nor damage.
[Bugfix] Battle - Fixed an issue where spinner weapon to weapon hits would sometimes completely negate any spinner impulse.
[Bugfix] Battle - Fixed an issue where hitting the arena would prevent any spindown from occurring.
[Bugfix] Battle - Fixed an issue where hitting the arena would sometimes apply way too little spindown and recoil.

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: kupa_!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

Hi all, kupa_ here, one of the developers of Robot Rumble 2, here with another Dev Diary update. This month we have been mostly working on improvements to our Arena Mod Tool, adding new features gameplay features to our arenas and, of course, continuing our bug crushing mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/fe6d982bd5fb4edbad9e48f3feca5d43a3fc9c88.png[/img]

One of the things I would like to take the time to talk about today is our fantastic community. As I have mentioned many times before we wouldn't be anything without the love and support of the wonderful community we have built up over the years and I just wanted to shout out some of the amazing events they have curated. Every month on the Official RR2 Discord we have a community run Bot of the Month competition where all builders are invited to enter their works of mechanical art to be featured on our Discord. Above is a picture of three beautiful bots that won both their respective months and then the year end Bot of the Year community vote. Beautiful work by Peanits with King Krustacean and 4NDR3W T4T3 taking the 2nd and 3rd podium with The Velocitizer and Outlaw!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/71500706809ee2d8343c444a030ef1872e1194e4.png[/img][i]Beetleweight replicas of our stock bots HONK (Hoot) and Launch Control (Fling Guidance) go head to head with beautifully fiery results. Bots built by @blooper_bee on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

On the development side, as mentioned before, we have been working hard on version 1.2 of our Arena Mod Tool (AMT). The AMT is the tool we use to create the arenas featured in the game, and is also freely available for anyone to create their own arenas with. Some of the new features include the ability to have dynamic text in arenas, as well as all new, highly requested, hazards such as Forced Countout Zones. We have also been adding requested improvements to the existing hazards such as being able to delay their firing, or even being able to randomise the effect of a trigger, allowing for much more chaotic results! We are hoping these additions allow our talented arena creators to create even more wild custom arenas down the line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/55db3211d3192ac58726d8591fb6958ab109b8d2.png[/img][i]Sparks and debris are sent flying across the arena as Gridlock and Zero Dark Hundred clash! Bots built by @iforgottobubble on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

Alongside the above, work continues on implementing Steam Workshop Support and we cannot wait to share more news on this as we progress. That is all for this month, so once again thank you to everyone who has supported the game and we hope to see you again for next months dev diary!

kupa_
Robot Rumble 2
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2


[i]This updates header features Hermit by built by yours truly.[/i]

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: Prisma!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

Happy Feburary Robot Rumble 2 Community!

My name is Brendan aka Prisma, and I am one of the developers from the Robot Rumble 2 Dev Team. In this post I'll be telling y'all more about myself, looking back at 2024 to see what we accomplished, and tease our most-requested feature that we are working on!

[h3]About Prisma[/h3]
I've been a part of this wonderful game community since December 2020 and have been helping develop since September 2022. I'm very thankful to be a part of the dev team, because my work on Robot Rumble 2 actually helped me get a real job as a Unity developer. A big thank you to Chris for having me on the team and helping pave my future. A lot of my work on Robot Rumble 2 has been quality of life improvements such as the Open Robot Folder button, weld help button, and Discord Rich Presence! In addition, I've helped with figuring out how to get the game to work on Mac OS with both Intel and Apple Silicon CPUs. I've also been working on one of our most requested features that I'll talk about later~.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/457e148603083bf920aa2f7898e1ead144f503d6.png[/img][i]Deuteranopia beheads poor Cheesus while taking a massive strike itself![/i]

I first got into robot combat back when I was on a First Robotics Competition team in 2016. My friend told me about this show on TV where robots fought each other, so I tuned in out of curiosity. Next thing I know, I'm rooting for Bombshell as it goes from a wild card all the way to being a finalist. From there I started looking for robot combat games before a few years later I find a little game called Robot Rumble 2.

[h3]It's Cheesin' Time[/h3]
I'm most known in the community for my robot Cheesus that most of you know from the stock pack. Cheesus holds a very special place in my heart because of how many people seem to enjoy it. It originated from Robot Rumble 2, but I have also built it in Garry's Mod as well as in real life as a Viper kit and later a custom 1lb robot. I've had crowds and BattleBots team members chanting my robot's name, and I've even had someone ask for an autograph from Cheesus as well as asking if Cheesus would be okay after it lost a match. And yes, I do say, "It's Cheesin' Time" before a lot of my matches. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/60bf1778a455b1f5daca84758578f3eb6d6a2205.png[/img][i]Careless Twister and Rust let the sparks fly over the firepit of the Origin Arena! Bots built by @eli.the.boye on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

[h3]A Look Back[/h3]
2024 has been a big year for our team. We managed to get our game on Steam which was something we joked wouldn't happen for a long time. I never thought I'd be able to say that I am part of the dev team for a game that is on Steam. So what else did we do? Doyle and Kupa went crazy last with updates introducing new motors and component changes. Some highlights though have to be the photo mode during fights that allow us to get some wonderful photos of our robots! Another big update has to be the addition of Robot folders to allow for easy organization of all of our robots. I'm not joking when I say I know people with over 500 robot files! As I mentioned before, I also added Discord Rich Presence so that people can share what exciting things they are working on in the game. I wonder if we can integrate Robot Rumble 2 with anything else~?

[h3]The Future[/h3]
For 2025 we plan on continuing to push more updates to the game including adding more motors and features, adding and improving areas, fixing bugs, adding bugs, and going back to remove those added bugs. However, I know a lot of you are waiting to see what I've been teasing, so here's a little sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/6a379284de968722dbda492a6c3ab8b8aeab1f54.png[/img][i]The Robot Rumble 2 main menu with Steam user info and workshop status in the top left corner.[/i]

Yep! We are working on adding Steam Workshop support to Robot Rumble 2! The Steam Workshop is the perfect medium for sharing robots in the community. We don't have an estimate of how soon it'll be out, but in the meantime you can always join our Discord server to see and share many wonderful robots!

Once again, we would like to wish everyone a Happy New Year and we can't wait to build and battle even more this coming year!

Thank you,
Prisma
Robot Rumble 2
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Feature Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

We are pleased to announce the next major update for Robot Rumble 2! This update brings with it massive improvements to menu loading times - particularly for people with hundreds of bots - as well as squashing a fair number of bugs and introducing our next, highly requested, major feature: Undo/Redo in the BotLab!

As always, a full changelog can be found at the end of this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/2b364fb686881c43657d4b2bdb86cd35e5b82228.png[/img][i]A shower of sparks as the beetleweights Satan's Aguacate and Covert Inception collide. Bots built by @blooper_bee on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

The major feature for this update is the new Undo/Redo in the BotLab! This has easily been one of the most requested features for the game, and one we have been working on getting right for a while now. Such a seemingly small feature can sometimes turn out to be a much bigger puzzle to solve than originally anticipated, but we are proud to finally have this cracked and in the hands of our players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/f3b50d06aa7d3a59cdce8aa9bfa1ab9889030874.png[/img][i]A quick look at the new informational tooltips for the component categories.[/i]

Alongside the new Undo/Redo system we have introduced the first of our systems for improving the onboarding experience for new roboteers tackling the task of building their own combat machine for the first time: the Tooltip system! We have included lots of information to many of the buttons in the BotLab to give a set of mini-tutorials on how all the component types work together and hints on how to use them. Rest assured that we are taking player feedback on and still working on more ways to help teach this game to new roboteers. More news on what we are working on soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/04c2b9eedb58bb3d90eecd5a51c5470d47a1ec04.png[/img][i]A massive hit between Resistance is Futile and MkIII KiloNova sends sparks hurtling through the air. Bots built by @squawkingchickenrobotics on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

Our resident arena designer has been hard at work improving and updating the default arenas adding in new backstage areas, improving the audio and graphical effects, updating the lighting, and even completely rebuilding the US style arena from scratch. In the previous couple of Dev Diaries we have hinted at this work and shown some previews, so be sure to keep reading those in the future for more sneak peaks at what we are working on. We have some very exciting news in the next one, so be sure to come back and take a peek in a couple weeks time.

Thank you once again for your support, and we cannot wait to see you in the arena!

- The Robot Rumble 2 Team
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/445b8a99ecd9164588ed3c0973c1b8618e14675b.png[/img][i]Another massive clash from tiny robots as the beetleweights Distinguished Gentleman and Gold Widow brawl it out. Bots build by @eli.the.boye on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

[i]This updates header features Midnight Sun and Longtail by @jordanobviouslyrobotics on the RR2 Discord.[/i]

[Added] Mouseover tooltip system.

⚠️ - The first time you load in to a folder this might take a little longer due to needing to update the botfiles within to the latest version, after that first load though you should see the optimisation kick in.

This improves the ablative effect of weaker materials like plastics, reducing the throw effect. It will also increase damage output, as spinners will keep much more speed.

[Change] Arena - RR2 UK renamed to UK Arena.

[Change] Arena - Arena Robot Rumble Changed to Robot Rumble Arena
[Change] Arena - All default arenas have new "3 2 1 battle" sequences and voiceover, and a horn has been added at end of a match.

[Bugfix] Fix bots falling apart when you restart a fight after using slowdown.

[Bugfix] BotLab - Fix a potential overwrite issue with bots created via cloning.
[Bugfix] Battle - Camera no longer tracks bots that have been eliminated.
[Bugfix] Battle - Rendering issue that was causing "Voids" to appear during PostProcessing step.

[Bugfix] BotLab - Minor tooltip corrections.

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: kupa_!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

Hi all! My name is Reece, better known as kupa_, and I am one of the developers of Robot Rumble 2. I have been a part of the project since December 2019 so it is almost my fifth anniversary in the team! Time sure does fly when you're having fun, and it has been a huge honour watching the game, and the community, grow like it has over the years!

I originally came on board to build out the tooling and implementation of custom arenas, leading to the Arena Modding Tool and thus the huge amount of player created arenas we have today. Since then I have had my hand in pretty much every aspect of the game with a primary focus on bug-fixes and implementing some of the most popular community requests. Most recently I have been working away on the final implementation of the Undo/Redo system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/5d9f2dfcddc77264c82a6170e3c370f1b103a66d.png[/img][i]A clash of titans as Pcore 18s spinner meets the might of Harmacists massive disk! Bots built by Aki.[/i]

Joining the Robot Rumble team has truly been a lifelong dream come true. I remember when I was a kid that a friend of mine got a brand new Sega Genesis one Christmas, alongside a copy of Sonic the Hedgehog 2. Watching them play through the game with such a huge smile on their face ignited a passion within me, alongside a simple (or so I thought at the time) goal: [i]I want to make games and bring that level of joy to others![/i]

Seeing the insane levels of creativity and passion on display every day in the Robot Rumble 2 community brings me so much joy and pushes me to keep on improving the game as much as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/d99e2f8a7a3735bad9a1dbfef043e922e753397c.png[/img][i]A huge impact as Infernos flaming hammer crashes down on to Crucial Fracture! Bots built by Jerrie.[/i]

In the last diary we showed off our progress on the new and improved default RR2 US Arena, as well as touching on the Undo/Redo system coming soon. While Undo/Redo is still the main focus of the next major update we have also been working on various ideas on how to best to onboard new roboteers. Included in the next major update will be a new tooltip system that is designed to offer extra information and detail on the various component types in the game. These should hopefully help newer players understand how to construct a fighting machine and how all the different parts interact with each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/3c89e0e117ddff2e050ad506ecf3457fac8f1c43.png[/img][i]An example of the new tooltip system that will be coming in the next major update![/i]

Once again, we thank you for your support and cannot wait to be able to show you more in the near future!

See you all again soon,
kupa_
Robot Rumble 2
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Dev Diary: Chris Bruce!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

Dear Robot Rumble 2 community,

My name is Chris Bruce, and I am the owner of Nerd Island Studios, creators of Robot Rumble 2.  It has been a full month since we released the game on Steam, almost five years since we first released the game on itch.io, and over seven years since we started the project with the goal of creating the best robot combat simulator we could make.  None of that would have been possible without your support and enthusiasm.

Over the next few months we will be shining a spotlight on a different member of the development team.  Each will be giving their own take on what it means to be a RR2 developer, and will be sharing some insights into the game dev process.  We hope you enjoy the series!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/9b9ccad025c97e926e05e99b9dd4a5109fd55420.png[/img][i]Massive sparks fly as the two mighty spinners of Kabagon and Brutal Belial clash! Bots built by Ranking.[/i]

Since the Steam release of Robot Rumble 2 the team has been hard at work delivering improvements and new features to the game. We've had our first major update introducing new ways to manage your bot lists, as well as releasing the game for Mac. Alongside these features were a myriad of improvements for performance and overall stability of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/f6ad9afb8cad4eda6b75b2d8228745ee13c296c7.png[/img][i]A battered Caffeine Machine lies in tatters at the end of a match well fought! Bot built by nathansilver.[/i]

The development team are still working away on the next major feature update, bringing with it a long time requested feature: Undo/Redo states in the BotLab! This has been one of those projects that has been in the works for a long time but the actual implementation was always a bit of a tricky one to get right. We are hoping this change is a massive improvement to the quality of life when using the BotLab going forward. We are also putting a lot of focus in to the onboarding of new roboteers and have been internally testing some ideas to bring new players in to the game and to help guide them through what it takes to build a functional combat robot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/2a8739ce26de9d4c6055a73a281c547e946b2773.png[/img][i]Deutronopia and Launch Control duke it out in the new and improved default US Arena, coming soon![/i]

Thank you all once again for the support and encouragement over the years of development and we cannot wait to show you what we've been working on more in future updates and Dev Diary entries.

Sincerely,
Chris Bruce
Project Lead

notes.title: Robot Rumble 2 - Feature Update and Mac Release!
notes.content:
[h2]Roboteers, stand by![/h2]

We are pleased to announce the first update for Robot Rumble 2 since our Steam Release. This update brings with it some much needed changes to navigation and organisation of bots, as well as implementing some highly requested features and cracking a few bugs along the way. Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to give us feedback and report such issues, it is always super appreciated and helps us create the best robot combat simulator out there!

More details and a full changelog can be found below, but we just wanted to quickly say a [b]massive[/b] thank you to all who have tried out our game! Reading through your posts in the discussions forums, on our Discord, and in the Steam Reviews (71 reviews at the time of writing with a Very Positive score!) has been a massive highlight of our time working on the game. But enough about us, let's jump in to the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/a15681dbf1b7af5ebd83c09998a05cef119c2893.jpg[/img]
[i]Say hello to our new and improved Workshop bot select screen! So much tidier.[/i]

The major feature for this update is the new Folder system that can be seen when selecting your bots for both the Workshop and the Battle modes. The new tools introduced for this change allow you to easily organise your bots, whether that be by weightclass, weapon archetype, or however you see fit. You can now create and delete folders from within the game, as well as move your bots between these folders or even clone them right in the menu, allowing a lot more freedom and making new variants of a design much simpler to start building.

Our stock included bots are also now included in their own folder by default, meaning you can rush straight in to battle without needing to go through the (admittedly slightly confusing) step of importing them first. Thank you to everyone who reported this as not being very user friendly, we are hoping that this change improves onboarding considerably.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/e8225f1d91b983aefcbf5415da14461c7d6239e6.png[/img]
[i]SHTCC10 tosses it's older sibling SHTCC9 across the arena with ease! Bots built by Scoconut.[/i]

Another highly requested feature that this update brings is the ability to search for a specific bot in the bot selection menus. We've seen members in our Discord server with hundreds of bot files, and trying to find the one bot you want to battle with became a massive pain, however with this new feature this should be a worry of the past! Robot hoarders rejoice!

We have also integrated the Discord SDK in to the project, allowing for Rich Presence within Discord when playing the game. Now your friends can see what you're up to in more detail. For example when you are building a bot the name of the bot is now included in your profile for that extra touch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/78c33ca3b15c41fcf1d0201076e097fb3acf7093.png[/img]
[i]Beyond Lethal takes a mighty bite out of Bullet Dragon! Bots built by Powerrave.[/i]

The last big news for this update is the inclusion of macOS support for the game! Now no matter how you choose to play, whether that be on Windows, Mac, or Linux (through Proton) you can enter the arena with no limits. We are very excited to be able to bring Apple users in to the fray with us, as this has been a long term target for the team.

Alongside the above new features we have been hard at work improving performance and quality of life for our users. Tweaks have been made to the post-processing options and various menus and data popups have been made more informational and legible. We have also been crushing some bugs to do with spinner physics and damage, alongside the battle state not being set correctly when a robot is timed out.

One of the key pieces of feedback we have been seeing come up is the difficulty in onboarding for new roboteers, and this is being treated as a huge priority going forward. One of our long term goals is to create a platform that can make the thrill of robot more approachable (and let's be honest, more affordable) to everyone who has an interest in the sport. Work is ongoing to improve player onboarding whilst also presenting all the information required for advanced roboteers to push the limits of their designs.

See you in a couple of weeks for our first Developer update where we will show off some of the things we are currently working on and talk more about how development is going!

Thank you once again for your support, and we cannot wait to see you in the arena!

- The Robot Rumble 2 Team
https://discord.gg/RobotRumble2


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34156446/50d5a6a39fb0e079c54d37f268979ae70ddc8ef3.png[/img]
[i]Sparks fly as Asenath lands a powerful blow against Shield! Bots built by daaz.[/i]

[Change] Unified design of popup windows.

[Change] Removed experimental warning from Arena Damage.

[Change] Moved the robot preview screen in BotLab Selection up a little to avoid overlap with new UI elements.

[Change] Moved parts graveyard innitiation to start() as this logic was surprisingly CPU intensive and was called for every part, this may have been a cause for slightly worse performance since steam release.

[Bugfix] Removed two strange white objects in background at certain angles in BotLab Green Screen.
[Bugfix] Certain unwelded parts not being tidied up when resetting bot or exiting in BotLab Test Cages.
[Bugfix] Reworked Arena damage, it now works great! Just make sure to not put your electric components on the outer shell of your robot!

[Bugfix] Bots that are counted out due to immobility are now disabled. (Now matches will end with the surviving bot being declared the winner when all other bots are disabled).
[Bugfix] Bots that are counted out due to immobility no longer display an unmoving 10 second timer.
[Bugfix] Fixed an issue where damage to a part was spread incorrectly across several welds, causing some damage to be "lost"
[Bugfix] Fixed a small miscalculation in weld damage where spent damage was not subtracted from the total damage of a spinner hit
[Bugfix] Removed code that sometimes prevented a glancing hit from applying damage, due to the first (weak) contact applying a "invincibility period"
[Bugfix] Fixed damage of several hits to the same part in the same frame would only take the highest damage, every hit is now added up
[Bugfix] Fix to apply the spinner slowdown on Arena hits and on the hit impulse too.
[Bugfix] Camera in Battle reverting to wrong camera slot when unpausing.
[Bugfix] Graphics settings in Battle not applying until camera change occurs.
[Bugfix] Settings being reset on first load.
[Bugfix] Optimized Discord checking the robot name to not call a find function every frame.
[Bugfix] Camera not tracking robot after resetting bot in BotLab Test Cage.
[Bugfix] Potential fix for Macs not being able to create collision shapes for chassis and custom shape parts.
